disposition_rationale: No silent regeneration performed; no seed-shopping performed (seed drawn once via os.urandom before any audit).
Excluding overlapping episodes would mutate the frozen 70k battery post-hoc and break the preregistered total/strata contract.
Regenerating or filtering until zero overlap would condition H5 on avoiding H4L, i.e. make H5 a DIFFERENT distribution - exactly the outcome-targeted tuning forbidden by the H5 charter.

Overlapping episodes are provably non-informative for this survivor set: K2 left 63/63 K1 survivors over the FULL H4L bank, so every overlapping episode was already survived by all 63 K6 candidates. Any H5 kill must therefore come from a strictly novel episode; freeze step asserts this mechanically.
Freshness is reported exactly, not as 70k-fresh: 63339 strictly novel episodes carry the fresh falsification power; 6661 overlaps are already-survived replays.
finding: H5 shares 6661/70000 episode IDs with H4L (byte-identical content, verified on all 6661). Zero-overlap expectation was mathematically unattainable for this distribution.
forbidden_alternatives_rejected: silent regeneration (forbidden: DO NOT silently regenerate H5)
post-hoc exclusion of overlaps (would mutate the frozen battery and break total/strata contract)
overlap_concentration: DOUBLE_DELETE_DOUBLE_KEEP + NESTED_INTERVAL + REPEATED_KEEP_DRAIN (+ small MIRROR_PAIRED); all other strata ~0 overlap at every size.
pigeonhole: REPEATED_KEEP_DRAIN at n=18 admits at most ~7 history-lengths x 18 keys x 3 deterministic shapes = ~378 deterministic contents; per-stratum quota is 834. H4L necessarily exhausts that subspace, so any same-distribution replication MUST collide (observed 361). Same argument holds for DOUBLE_DELETE_DOUBLE_KEEP (adjacent-pair cores) and NESTED_INTERVAL (center+deterministic offsets). Zero overlap is unattainable without changing the distribution.
structural_cause: Three strata have content spaces of order hundreds-to-thousands of episodes at small n while per-stratum quotas are 833-834/size. H4L already near-exhausts those subspaces; same-distribution replication necessarily recollides.
verification: Every overlapping ID was verified byte-identical in full content (size/stratum/shape/T0/H) across both banks, not merely hash-equal.
